0022600191.text: The Cavaliers (5-4) are second in the Central, 1.5 games back and sixth in the East, with a 4-1 home record and a 1-3 road record, and they enter on a one-game winning streak. The Knicks (4-4) are seventh in the East, three games back in the Atlantic, and riding a two-game winning streak. Cleveland is missing Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow), all listed as out, while New York is without Josh Hart (ankle). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Cleveland lost 1-2 to New York in the 2025-26 season and was swept 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, with the most recent meeting a 130-93 Cavaliers loss in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
